analysis.reasonEn: Current price $1.33 is at 20.2% of the 52-week low $0.99, nearing the swing support at $1.33 matching the 5-day low. RSI is at 38.1, entering oversold territory, and MACD histogram at -0.0209 shows continued weakness. A Lower High pattern is forming as the 5-day high is below the 20-day high, indicating a bearish bias. Volume increased by 1.36x the 5-day average, but trend reversal signals are weak, warranting a wait-and-see approach.
